newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina confirms $750 mln global bond delayed. [CORRECTED 16:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Argentina confirms $750 mln global bond delayed. [CORRECTED 16:20 GMT]

text.p: An Argentine official confirmed Wednesday (Corrects from Tuesday) that the government has decided to delay the launch of a planned $750 million seven-year global bond issue because of volatility in emerging markets.
"This measure has been taken as a consequence of the volatility we are seeing in yields in emerging countries," said the Economy Ministry official, who asked not be be named.
Argentina's Finance Undersecretary Miguel Kiguel had said Monday that the global bond would be issued this week.
But Credit Suisse First Boston, the joint lead manager, said in London Wednesday that the bond had been delayed due to market volatility.
